memory_law: Memory is typed, source-linked, versioned and graph-linked.
Retrieval frequency increases accessibility/relevance, not truth.
Repeated copies from one source do not become independent corroboration.
Node-local memory does not own global truth.
Immutable source references are preserved even when derived memory is superseded.
Rejected hypotheses may remain in contradiction/negative memory when useful for future falsification.

channels.purpose: Preserve exact or referenced source custody, source fragments, source metadata, direct observations and Point-Zero-adjacent material.
channels.epistemic_rule: Content records what the source/observation contains; it is not automatically objective world truth.

channels.purpose: Persist bounded Events, Event boundaries, prior/resulting states, Event lineage and Event-level growth history.
channels.epistemic_rule: Event existence/state may be direct, inferred or synthetic; epistemic status must remain attached.

channels.purpose: Persist stated, inferred and synthetic live-intent structures separately from motive and action outcome.
channels.epistemic_rule: New wording is not new intent; material novelty requires a changed target/state-change/priority/action tendency/constraint/relationship/time horizon/expected consequence.

channels.purpose: Persist typed edges among sources, Events, actors, states, parameters, containers, rubrics, Nodes, evidence, patterns and Sequences.
channels.epistemic_rule: Link != merge; relation existence and relation meaning each require provenance/evidence.

channels.purpose: Persist typed ordered routes, dependency chains, reverse traces, forward traces, counter-Sequences and recursive Point-Zero paths.
channels.epistemic_rule: Repeated traversal of the same path does not become independent evidence.

channels.purpose: Persist Pattern Contributions, Pattern Candidates, approved reusable patterns, compression structures, counterexamples and applicability boundaries.
channels.epistemic_rule: Pattern candidate != law. Reuse across independent contexts plus survived counterexamples increases maturity.

channels.purpose: Persist observed evidence, source-stated evidence, evidence predictions, absence tests, qualification outcomes and independence groups.
channels.epistemic_rule: Predicted evidence is not observed evidence. Source-copy multiplicity does not increase independent support count.

channels.purpose: Persist contradictions, failed hypotheses, counter-cases, incompatible actor/intention models, falsifier outcomes and unresolved tensions.
channels.epistemic_rule: Contradictions are preserved; no silent averaging or deletion merely because one branch currently leads.

channels.purpose: Persist actor-specific View State, body/emotional/social/resource state, relationship history and active brain-state variants without converting transient state into permanent identity.
channels.epistemic_rule: Same actor may have many active states over time; actor state != fixed personality.

channels.purpose: Persist open/closed Sequence contracts, Sub-Sequence requests, returns, closures, Seeds, barriers, triggers, thresholds and execution trace references.
channels.epistemic_rule: Closed Sequence remains immutable; later evidence creates a new referencing Sequence.

channels.purpose: Hold persistent bounded local service state, working-set summaries, unresolved items, candidate outputs, local counters and accepted return references for one Node Brain.
channels.epistemic_rule: Local memory may hold candidates and working state; it does not become global truth by persistence alone.

channels.purpose: Provide graph-level retrieval keys and references across all persistent memory classes without duplicating or overwriting authoritative payloads.
channels.epistemic_rule: Index points to memory; it is not a second authoritative copy and does not strengthen truth by duplicate indexing.
